taft-theatre.mobility.1: Is there an elevator inside Taft Theatre? No, there is not an elevator. All balcony seats require climbing stairs.
taft-theatre.cognitive.1: Patrons requiring ADA, hearing-impaired, or visually-impaired seating must specify their needs at the time of ticket purchase.
ADA tickets can be purchased online at Ticketmaster.com or in person at the venue box office during operating hours.
taft-theatre.chronic.1: By purchasing tickets for the ADA section, you confirm that you or a member of your party requires reserved seating due to mobility or standing difficulties. To ensure that all guests enjoy an optimal viewing experience, you may be requested to remain seated in the ADA section throughout the event.
taft-theatre.sensory.1: Taft Theatre offers sign language interpretation upon request. Requests for sign language interpreting services must be received no later than 3 weeks before the event, and are subject to the availability of an interpreter. Please email info@tafttheatre.org to request an interpreter.
taft-theatre.chronic.3: The venue is equipped with a gender-neutral and ADA accessible bathrooms to the right of the theatre doors in the main lobby.
Dewey’s Pizza cheese and pepperoni slices are available for purchase at the Main Bar across from The Ballroom accessible via the stairs below the Lobby and the Balcony stand overlooking the Lobby.
taft-theatre.cognitive.2: Yes, service animals covered under ADA Regulations are allowed for concerts and events in the venue.
All guests entering the venue are subject to a metal-detector screening by way of magnetometer, visual inspection, and/or bag inspection conducted by venue security personnel.
taft-theatre.cognitive.3: The Taft Theatre Box Office is located inside the venue, accessible by entering through the far-left doors at the main entrance off East 5th Street.

eden-park.cognitive.2: Cincinnati Parks is committed to providing a quality experience at all our parks and facilities by providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request. To request an accommodation fill out a Reasonable Accommodation Request Form linked here.
heritage-bank-center.cognitive.1: Guests with specific accessibility needs should contact the venue in advance to arrange. Please try to call at least three days before the event, if possible.
heritage-bank-center.sensory.1: Heritage Bank Center offers sensory kits that you may check-out for patrons that are sensitive to auditory and visual stimulation. Kits include antiglare glasses, communication card, identification wristbands, noise-reducing ear covers, small "fidget" toy, sanitizing wipes & tissues, venue map & more. Please stop by the customer service desk (next to the main entrance) for more information.
heritage-bank-center.mobility.1: There are three elevators in the venue, behind sections 103, 124, and 137.
